svg.title: Bench efficiency by tier per tower
svg.desc: Small multiples, one per damage tower: efficiency divided by the tier target for every default bench config, grouped by highest tier, with the mean per tier joined by a line and the tolerance band shaded.
svg.text: Bench efficiency divided by its tier target, by highest tier
Each dot is one default config (graded scenario); the line joins the tier means. Band: target +-35%.
Target eta = 10 x [1, 1.05, 1.12, 1.3, 1.6, 2.5] mass per second per 1000 credits, so a flat line at 1.0
means efficiency rises with tier exactly as designed.
